tools.name: capabilities
tools.description: Free current prices, coverage and schemas.

tools.name: payment_capabilities
tools.description: Supported EVM chains, allowlisted USDC/USDT/EURC tokens and fees. No transfer.

tools.name: escrow_case
tools.description: Read a private registered-network case with a wallet-session Bearer token. Set contract for historical cases. No signing.

tools.name: prepare_escrow_action
tools.description:
Simulate a case action and return an unsigned wallet transaction. Never broadcasts.

Actions: accept, cancelUnaccepted, submit, approve, dispute, addEvidence,
resolve, propose, acceptProposal, timeout. Scope each eventual wallet
signature to the exact returned chain, contract, calldata and value.

tools.name: create_payment_request
tools.description:
Create a zero-service-fee allowlisted token request payable to the authenticated wallet.
Requires wallet-session Bearer token; reuse operation_id only for identical retries.
No funds move. There is no escrow protection for direct payments.

tools.name: payment_request_status
tools.description: Read payment request details and verified finalized receipt, if any.

tools.name: prepare_payment
tools.description:
Prepare an unsigned exact-amount allowlisted token transfer. Requires wallet-session Bearer token.
Does not sign, broadcast or authorize spending. Obtain scoped payer authorization
before signing. Never pay again after an uncertain result; reconcile its hash.

tools.name: solana_payment_capabilities
tools.description: Read Solana mainnet assets, token program, fees and escrow deployment status.

tools.name: create_solana_payment_request
tools.description: Create a Solana USDC/EURC request. Requires a Solana wallet-session Bearer token; no funds move.

tools.name: prepare_solana_payment
tools.description: Return an unsigned exact SPL-token transaction. Solana wallet session required. Never signs or broadcasts.

tools.name: quote_usdc_cross_chain_transfer
tools.description:
Quote a capped CCTP Standard USDC route. Requires wallet login and explicit recovery-policy acknowledgement.
A successful burn cannot be reversed by Vino; finish the same destination mint. Customer pays gas on both chains. No signing or broadcast.

tools.name: cross_chain_transfer_step
tools.description:
Inspect/prepare/reconcile an existing CCTP transfer. No signing or broadcast.
Steps: status, prepare-burn, burn (source hash), attestation, prepare-mint, mint (destination hash).
Preserve the route ID and existing hashes; a source burn is never proof of destination delivery.

tools.name: claim_worth_it
tools.description: Free. Confirmed claim amount, gas, net value, safety flags and action verdict. Includes free hashed evidence-receipt.

tools.name: collectible_quote
tools.description: Free. TRUE collectible amount per curve/escrow via unsigned simulated sweep; raw RPC overstates reality.

tools.name: launchpad_fee_audit
tools.description: Free. One-wallet scan across supported launchpads for unswept or unclaimed creator fees.

tools.name: agent_budget_guard
tools.description: Free. Deterministic read-only spend policy verdict for amount, destination, and approval ceiling. Caller supplies policy; unknown targets require review.

tools.name: allowance_risk_check
tools.description: Free. Live ERC-20 allowance, owner balance and spender-code check at one block; flags effectively unlimited approvals.

tools.name: tx_preflight
tools.description: Free. Unsigned EVM eth_call and gas estimate at a measured block; flags approvals and delegated target code. Never signs or broadcasts.

tools.name: x402_health_check
tools.description: Free. DNS-pinned public HTTPS probe of an x402 endpoint's 402 quote, price, network and recipient; no payment sent.

tools.name: dependency_report
tools.description: Free. Compare a live primary x402 quote with your saved baseline; detect price, network, asset, recipient and HTTP status changes. No payments sent; no uptime-history claim.

tools.name: launch_economics
tools.description: Free. Pons token-specific on-chain pool fee, creator share, initial buy, current deployer holdings and estimated launch-cost break-even volume.

tools.name: wallet_progress
tools.description: Free. Read live native and up to three specified ERC-20 balances at one block. Compare a caller-held baseline; no automatic asset discovery, valuation, or scheduled alerts.

tools.name: market_evidence_compare
tools.description: Free. Compare dated caller-supplied asks, sales, bids, pools, funding, liquidity or holders without mixing metrics. Evidence is not independently verified.

tools.name: defi_scenario_review
tools.description: Free. Calculate simple-APR returns after supplied fees and loss scenarios. Inputs are assumptions, not live quotes or recommendations.

tools.name: agent_job_brief
tools.description: Free. Create a structured work brief with deliverables, acceptance checks and budget. No provider hired, job submitted or payment sent.

tools.name: hyperliquid_watch
tools.description: Free. On-demand public Hyperliquid perp market snapshot with caller-selected funding and 24h price-move thresholds. No trading or scheduled push alerts.

tools.name: prepare_donation
tools.description: Optional support for Vino & Views. Prepare an unpaid NOWPayments donation checkout or a payment address/amount/network. Supply amount_usd, a UUID request_id reused for identical retries, and optional pay_currency. Creates no credits and sends no funds. Use only within your operator's authorized dona

tools.name: prepare_x402_donation
tools.description: Prepare an optional Base USDC x402 donation directly to Wallet EB. No transfer occurs here. Your x402 wallet signs and sends the HTTP payment within your operator-authorized budget. Existing report services remain free.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agent_budget_guard · Private data: payment_capabilities, escrow_case, prepare_escrow_action, create_payment_request, prepare_payment, solana_payment_capabilities, create_solana_payment_request, prepare_solana_payment, quote_usdc_cross_chain_transfer, launchpad_fee_audit, launch_economics, wallet_progress, prepare_x402_donation · Public sink: prepare_escrow_action, prepare_payment, quote_usdc_cross_chain_transfer, cross_chain_transfer_step, launch_economics.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: agent_budget_guard · Private data: payment_capabilities, escrow_case, prepare_escrow_action, create_payment_request, prepare_payment, solana_payment_capabilities, create_solana_payment_request, prepare_solana_payment, quote_usdc_cross_chain_transfer, launchpad_fee_audit, launch_economics, wallet_progress, prepare_x402_donation · Public sink: prepare_escrow_action, prepare_payment, quote_usdc_cross_chain_transfer, cross_chain_transfer_step, launch_economics

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
